window.reference: Observed gnb0>ue0 applied updates k=100 to k=399; approximately 29.9 radio seconds after 10-second warmup. Trace records use completion timestamps; control observation and buffering introduce boundary uncertainty.

note: Column 2 is a, 3 is b, 4 is c; units depend on trace producer. GPU GPT: launch, RM+LDPC launch, completion wait (us). GPG: GPU event span, host bit unpack and measurement readout (us); CPU CRC lies outside the unpack timer. GPU span includes stream scheduling intervals; it is not pure arithmetic time. Nested totals overlap; do not sum percentiles. Trace-enabled runs are diagnostic, separate from clean performance comparisons.
